page.layout: One printed page. Left of centre, a ruled table of years (1420 to 1428) with names of magistrates in italic, set in lines between horizontal rules. Years in the left margin beside the rows. Printed page number at the top. Right margin: marginal notes beside the table rows, in a narrow column. No running head, catchword or signature.

l.note: Buntflovius legatus in cum collegis in Frisia. P[?]ro DIPLOMA Imp. de li-bertate Frs. populo tradi[?]ta: & actio de pace tētata.

main_text.l: 1421 | Iidem Colloquia inter partes de pace. Transactio cum Ioanne Bavaro.
1422 | Iidem Generalis compositio inter omnes Frisios Groninga,
1426 | Iidem Compositio inter Occonem Broeccm. & Focconē Vconis F. autorib. Gron.
1427 | Brun Clinge. Focco bellum infert Gro-ninganis, & agrum ab iis separat.
1428 | Evert Hubbeldinge, Focco novarum [?]egum per agrum autor est.

page.notes: The years are printed in the left margin beside the rows; the first three names above 1420 carry no year and are likely the continuation of an earlier entry. Right-margin notes are placed beside the rows they stand against. The note beside 1420 is partly obscured at its line ends; "P[?]ro" and "tradi[?]ta" are uncertain. "li-bertate" is joined from a printed line-end hyphen; the left edge of the next line is damaged. "Gro-ninganis" is joined from a printed hyphen. The note on 1428 has an ink blot over "legum"; "[?]egum" is the best reading. A blot also covers part of "Mauriffinge" and "Suckinge" is uncertain. "Himrick[?]" is a doubtful reading. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The "ɷ" mark before "Mauriffinge" is probably an ampersand or ligature and is marked [?].
